quarterly_data.quarter: Rocket Lab press release: Rocket Lab Introduces High-Efficiency Solar Cell to Reduce (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rocket Lab announced the production release of IMM Apex, its latest Inverted Metamorphic space solar cell: 31.5% beginning-of-life conversion efficiency and 40% lower cell mass, free of the germanium substrates of conventional multi-junction cells (mitigating that critical mineral's rising costs and supply constraints), and a mechanical and electrical drop-in replacement for heritage germanium cells; it is available now and manufactured in multi-100-kilowatt volumes. More than 1,100 satellites on orbit are powered by Rocket Lab solar products.
quarterly_data.figure: 31.5% beginning-of-life efficiency; 40% lower cell mass; more than 1,100 satellites powered
